title.narrative: Joint Programme on Gender and Social Assistance in Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: The Gender and Social Assistance Programme in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) is a comprehensive joint initiative designed to address the deep-rooted socio-economic vulnerabilities that have been further exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic. At its core, the programme seeks to reduce gender-based violence (GBV), strengthen social protection systems, and promote inclusive economic opportunities through social entrepreneurship. Its rationale is grounded in the urgent need to respond to systemic inequalities and fragmented service delivery, particularly affecting women and marginalized communities. Drawing on over 15 years of experience by UN agencies in advancing gender equality in BiH, the programme aligns with key national and international frameworks, including the EU Gender Action Plan III, the Istanbul Convention, and the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2021–2025. It also supports BiH’s EU accession process by promoting institutional reforms and inclusive recovery.

participating-org.narrative: UNITED NATIONS DEVELOPMENT FUND FOR WOMEN (UN WOMEN)

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
